blocks.html: 100 Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Patrons Get to Bring a brand new LED TV

One hundred Robinsons Malls shoppers will get to bring home a brand new 24"Devant LED TV. All they have to do is present proof of any transaction from any of the government agency located inside Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center (RPLMC) to join the promo.

Lingkod Pinoy Centers are located in Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Damariñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Bacolod and Robinsons Place Gen San. What’s more exciting is another 100 set of lucky RMLPC customers from Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Damariñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Bacolod and Robinsons Place Gensan will get the chance to take home a Sun Cellular smartphone.
Customers who are 18 years old and above must present their proof of transaction with any government agency (DFA, DOT, GSIS, LTO, NBI, PAGIBIG, PHILHEALTH, PHILPOST, POEA, LRA, OWWA, SSS, and TESDA) within Lingkod Pinoy Center till June 30 (except weekends and June 12) at the designated promo booth. Every transaction entitles the customer to one raffle stub.

The lucky winners will be drawn on July 6 and will be notified through email. For more information, see posters and flyers for details. Visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or download the Robinsons App for details. Also, follow and like Robinsons Malls Facebook page (www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls), Twitter (www.twitter.com/RobinsonsMalls), and instagram (@RobinsonsMallsOfficial).
